functionalReqs: Send push (iOS, Android), SMS and email
Respect user opt-outs and per-channel preferences
hints: What should happen when the SMS provider is slow: should push and email wait for it?
Put a queue per channel between the notification API and channel workers, and keep preferences and device tokens in their own store.

Workers pull from per-channel queues, call providers with retries and exponential backoff, send repeated failures to a dead-letter queue, de-duplicate with an idempotency key, rate-limit per user, and record status for analytics.
nonFunctionalReqs: Soft real-time: most notifications delivered within seconds
One failing provider must not block other channels
problemStatement:
Design a service that other teams call to send **push notifications, SMS and emails** to users.

It must respect user preferences, survive slow or failing third-party providers (APNs, FCM, Twilio, SES), and never spam a user with duplicates.

scaleHints.qps: 10M notifications per day, bursts of 50K/s during campaigns

title: Design a Notification Service
